fields.sample_size: not a survey: bibliographic review, official statistics, systematic landscape observation with field diary and photographs, and cartographic representations for the Aguas-Lindas neighborhood (between Belem and Ananindeua, Para)
fields.effect_estimate: The Saneamento Para Todos water-access programme is an important infrastructural intervention but its implementation reinforces socio-spatial segregation because it disregards residents' socioeconomic situation, agency and effective popular participation in the programme's stages; analysed through the right-to-the-city framework. Qualitative-quantitative case study with no sample of respondents and no effect estimates.
fields.study_design: qualitative-quantitative case study of one neighborhood using documents, official statistics, field observation and cartography (no household survey)
fields.section: Full text: Metodologia (procedures a-d); Resultados e discussao; Consideracoes finais
fields.exact_location: Metodologia (procedures a-d); Resultados e discussao; Consideracoes finais

evidence_level: Single-study evidence: a case study of the Saneamento Para Todos water-access programme in the Aguas-Lindas neighborhood, Belem metropolitan area, read in full text 2026-10-04 (documents, official statistics, observation, mapping; no respondent survey). Implementation is argued to reinforce socio-spatial segregation and to lack popular participation.
